metadata.purpose: Validate the complete skirt-parent production workflow end to end after eliminating stale pre-skin MFnMesh reuse. Run planner, all parent transfers, production smoothing-plan construction, and production smoothing apply/ratio propagation with a fresh post-skin MFnMesh supplied only to the planner.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main and include commit 09d03161225928a3cde15afe1702a82ef70f3c5f or later.
Use a healthy managed Maya 2024 session with startup_timeout=90 and operation_timeout=45, force a fresh unsaved scene, and do not save or quit Maya.

Use the pre-skin MFnMesh only to derive root_loop. After skinCluster creation and bulk weight initialization, resolve a brand-new MSelectionList/MFnMesh and pass that fresh post-skin function set to run_skirt_parent_workflow via planner kwargs.
Use the real selector/polySelect adapter. Do not forward mesh_fn or selector overrides into production build_smoothing_plan(plan).

Require a closed plan with four assignments and four spans, four transfer results with changed components, four smoothing-plan operations, four smoothing apply results, parent weight near zero and skirt-joint total near one on a changed sample, and at least one smoothing result with propagated ratio data.

If PASS, accept the advanced skirt-parent workflow Maya slice and treat stale MFnMesh lifetime across history mutation as the resolved root cause for the prior crash chain. If FAIL, preserve exact evidence and isolate the first full-workflow stage not already proven by 036p/036q.
